name: PT Alkindo Naratama Tbk
summary: PT Alkindo Naratama Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells conversion paper products in Indonesia. The company operates through Paper, and Chemical and Others segments. The company offers papers for paper core, paper box, paper bag, hexa wrap, paper cup, paper bowl, paper tube, honeycomb board, and edge protector industries, as well as kraft liners, eco boards, and core boards. It manufactures and sells water-based polymers for wood, paint, and roof coating industries under the ALFACHEM, ALFABOND, and ALFACOAT trademarks; engages in trading and industrial manufacturing; operates as an agent and distributor of dyes and textile chemicals; and provides logistics services.
